Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 17859 of 2023
Petitioner :- Smt. Babli

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 8 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Atul Kumar Srivastava,Ankit Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1. Heard Sri Atul Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Virendra Kumar Pal,
learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  This writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to direct the respondent authorities concerned to conduct just, fair, proper and transparent investigation in the instant case within stipulated period fixed by this Hon'ble Court and a further prayer to direct the respondent nos.2 and 3 to take legal action against the respondent nos.4 to 9/accused persons and arrest them pertaining to Case Crime No.0045 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 376, 377, 307, 511 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Milak Khanam, District Rampur.

sentences.text: In the present case, admittedly charge sheet no.49 of 2022 has already been forwarded to the Court.
Accordingly, we find that the present writ petition is misconceived.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he wants to withdraw this petition.
5. In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
